tagline: LightCraft on a Selkies web desktop, a photo library and raw developer that sits right next to the photos on your array.
description: LightCraft, a photo library and raw developer in the spirit of Lightroom, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: LightCraft
